Hello! We are students from Atyrau High School. We love hackhathon and design games. Our team is going to create story-driven Roblox game about space mission. 

Nowadays kids love playing games on different platforms and we want to use their interests. We also love play videogames and we decided to invent our idea. 

We are motivated,open to ideas and focused on fiishing something cool and playable.
summary: We created "Orion-7," an interactive Roblox game where players control support robots to keep a 5-person crew alive during a 3-minute journey between space stations. We named the project "Orion-7" after NASA’s Orion spacecraft, with "7" representing the 5 astronauts plus the 2 key pillars of survival: physical and mental health. To design the mechanics, we used NASA Human Research data on real space hazards like radiation, stress, isolation, and fatigue. We made the gameplay simple and intuitive: players watch live status bars for each astronaut and click specific ship tools—such as radiation shields, medical kits, or stress-relief modules—before any bar drops to zero. We chose a 3-minute timer to simulate a critical high-risk phase, like passing through a solar storm, where fast robot reactions save lives. This project matters because it makes complex space science easy and fun to understand
details:
Project Details — ORION-7

ORION-7 is an interactive space survival game developed in Roblox Studio. Players take the role of support robots responsible for protecting a crew of five astronauts during a time-limited, three-minute space mission. They must monitor each astronaut’s physical and psychological condition, respond to emergencies, and use available medical and protective resources. If even one crew member dies, the mission ends. Players aim to save the entire crew, achieve the highest score, and complete the mission in the best possible time.

The project is inspired by NASA’s Human Research Program, which identifies major risks of human spaceflight, including radiation, isolation, confinement, altered gravity, and hostile environments. ORION-7 transforms these complex challenges into accessible gameplay, helping players understand why astronaut health, psychological resilience, and quick decision-making are essential for mission success.

Our team wanted to create something more than another survival game. We explored what makes games appealing to younger generations — their visual style, creativity, storytelling, and engaging mechanics — and looked for a way to combine these qualities with educational value. We chose a retro-inspired visual style, drawing inspiration from classic games enjoyed by older generations, while introducing a modern space setting and a meaningful mission. The result combines entertainment with learning about space exploration, human health, teamwork, and emergency response.

The name ORION-7 reflects our concept: Orion represents both a well-known constellation and NASA’s Orion spacecraft, designed to carry astronauts on missions to the Moon and beyond. The number seven represents our five developers and two essential pillars of crew survival: physical health and psychological resilience. It also symbolizes good fortune and humanity’s long-standing curiosity about the seven celestial bodies known to ancient sky-watchers.

Tools and technologies: Roblox Studio, Python, and Claude AI assistant. AI was used as a supporting tool during the development process.
